reference: T006 transport decision based on the T005 runtime compatibility findings: the frozen openapi-fetch 0.17.0 cannot be packaged or loaded by the WeChat DevTools toolchain, so formal transport implementation is stopped and a targeted technical Authority change is requested.
head: 3f3c9310f324e4d579b51945b15ace62ca5db232

design.selector: 微信开发者工具负责原生项目编译、预览与上传

environment: Decision derived from the T005 probe run on iPhone 16, iOS 26.6.2, WeChat 8.0.80, runtime SDK 3.18.1 with WeChat DevTools 2.02.2609250. Probe implementation head 3f3c931; base 31cb32f (post-admission main).

operations.action: Evaluate whether the frozen openapi-fetch build can reach the target device through the DevTools npm pipeline
operations.expected: A supported packaging route ships the exact library build to the device
operations.actual: FAIL: the DevTools npm build cannot resolve the package entry (dist/index.mjs unsupported) and produces no miniprogram_npm; the alternative hand-made CJS layout compiles but is absent from the 10,458 B preview package

operations.action: Evaluate the device behavior of the probe with the frozen library
operations.expected: The probe page loads and reports runtime observations
operations.actual: FAIL: the page renders blank because the library import fails before page registration

operations.action: Record the T006 decision without substituting an unapproved transport
operations.expected: Decision recorded as incompatible with a STOP for T007 onward and a targeted Authority change request
operations.actual: Recorded incompatible; formal transport not implemented; wx.request thin adapter remains the pre-identified candidate but requires Authority approval

defects.description: Frozen openapi-fetch 0.17.0 is incompatible with the WeChat DevTools packaging toolchain and cannot be loaded on the target runtime within the authorized scope.

unverified: Device-level openapi-fetch semantics (Request/Response/Headers, 200/401, rejection, cancel) remain unverified because the library cannot be loaded on the target.
No replacement transport has been implemented or validated; any alternative requires a targeted technical Authority change first.
